caseno: Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 88 of 2010.
lawyer:
Mvi Md Wahidullah, Advocate-on-Record—For the Petitioner 

None Represented—For the Respondent
full_judgment:
Md. A Wahhab Miah J: In this petition, the accused-petitioner has called in question the order dated the 11th day of October, 2009 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 29242 of 2009 summarily rejecting an application filed by her under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure (the Code). 

 3. On the basis of the said FIR, Bheramara Police Station Case No. 7 dated 14-7-2007 under sections 302/109/34 of the Penal Code was started against the FIR named accused Jony. Police arrested the said FIR named accused Jony and during investigation, he made a confessional statement before the Magistrate First Class on 15-7-2007 under section 164 of the Code implicating himself, Selim, Milon and the accused-petitioner with the murder of deceased, Shamima Akhter Baby. After investigation, police submitted charge-sheet in the case against the FIR named accused, Jony under section 302/34 of the Penal Code and non-FIR named accused, Milon and Selim under sections 302/109/34 of the Penal Code; the police submitted final report against the accused-petitioner. Eventually, there was a judicial inquiry on the basis of naraji petition filed by the informant and on the basis of the report of the judicial inquiry, the petitioner's name was included in the charge sheet and then the charge-sheet was accepted by the Senior Judicial Magistrate, Kushtia on 10-7-2008. The relevant portion of the order reads as follows:— 

 Then, the record of the case was sent to the Court of Sessions Judge, Kushtia where the case was registered as Sessions Case No. 276 of 2008. The learned Sessions Judge took cognizance in the case against the petitioner and others under sections 302/109/34 of the Penal Code. In the meantime, the petitioner filed an application under section 265C of the Code to discharge her from the case. The Sessions Judge by his order dated 23-11-2008 transferred the case to the Court of Additional Sessions Judge, Second Court, Kushtia for trial and disposal. The learned Additional Sessions Judge by his order dated 20-1-2009 rejected the prayer of the accused-petitioner and the other co-accused, Milon Biswas for discharging them from the case and thereafter by order dated 2-9-2009 framed charge against all the accused including the petitioner under section 302/34 of the Penal Code and fixed the next date for examination of witnesses. At that stage of the case, the petitioner filed an application before the High Court Division under section 561A of the Code for quashing the proceedings. A motion Bench which heard the application summarily rejected the same; hence this petition. 

 5. From the impugned order, it appears that the point on which the petitioner sought to quash the proceedings is that she is innocent, but 'cognizance has been taken' against her upon a confessional statement of co-accused, Jony who implicated her in the case out of previous enmity and that the allegation that has come up from the confessional statement is preposterous. The High Court Division summarily rejected the application simply saying that the prayer of the accused-petitioner "does not come under the five point formulation of principle regarding quashment" without outlining the five points. The High Court Division wrongly observed that "after further investigation, the accused-petitioner has been implicated in this case on the basis of confessional statement (sic) Jony". As stated earlier the accused-petitioner was included in the charge-sheet on the basis of the report of the judicial inquiry held by a judicial Magistrate and then cognizance was taken against her by the learned Sessions Judge under sections 302/109/34 of the Penal Code and charge has already been framed against her along with others under section 302/34 of the Penal Code.
